note: Cosmos-Transfer2.5 params file — multicontrol variant (depth + edge combined). Shape mirrors the robot_multicontrol_spec.json pattern scraped from the Cosmos Transfer2.5 quickstart. The proxy-video.mp4, depth.exr, and canny/ directory referenced here are produced by scripts/generate-control-bundle.sh — they are gitignored binary derivatives.

depth.note: Depth from MiDaS monocular estimation on the proxy video. Gate 3+ will replace with Lyra's authoritative per-frame depth.

edge.note: Canny edges from OpenCV per-frame. Thresholds are defaults — tune if Cosmos rejects.

segmentation.note: Not used in Gate 2 dry-run. Revisit if Cosmos output has object-identity drift across frames.

blur.note: Not used in Gate 2 dry-run. Useful for camera-motion-blur stylization at Gate 4 productization.

inference.note: Guidance 3.0 matches the Cosmos Transfer2.5 quickstart default. Seed locked for reproducibility during Gate 2.c benchmarking.

downstream_consumer: Stage 5 — Cosmos-Transfer2.5 NIM on GCP Cloud Run GPU (L4 dev / A100 prod)
